question: How is immense material wealth contrasted with the value of the kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
This comparison sets up the teaching's superiority
inference: Even wealth vast enough to fill the ocean with jewels is inferior to this teaching.
uncertainties: The fused form ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is difficult to parse precisely.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
